name: Northfold Coffee Roasters
description: Single-origin coffee, roasted to order and delivered within 48 hours.

theme.imageStyle: Editorial film photography, warm natural window light, shallow depth of field, earthy palette of oat, terracotta and deep green, calm and unstaged, no faces

intro.heading: Coffee roasted *the morning* it ships.
intro.body: Single-origin beans from six farms we know by name, roasted to order and on your doorstep within 48 hours.

media.prompt: Filter coffee being hand-poured into a glass carafe on a pale oak counter, a kraft paper bag of coffee beans beside it, soft morning light from a window
media.alt: Pour-over coffee beside a bag of Northfold beans

intro.heading: Built around *freshness*, not shelf life.
intro.body: Supermarket coffee is often months old before you open it. Ours has not been roasted yet when you place the order.

blocks.title: Roasted to order, never to stock
blocks.body: Each bag is stamped with its roast date and the name of the person who roasted it.

image.prompt: Freshly roasted coffee beans tumbling out of a small drum roaster into a cooling tray, light steam rising

blocks.label: the oldest any bag has been on arrival

blocks.title: Direct from six farms
blocks.body: We pay 2.4 times the Fairtrade minimum and publish every price.

blocks.title: Skip, pause or swap any time
blocks.body: Change beans, grind or delivery day with one text message. No account page to fight with.

image.prompt: Red coffee cherries drying on long raised beds on a hillside farm, hands spreading them out
image.alt: Coffee cherries drying on raised beds

blocks.title: Fits the letterbox
blocks.body: Recyclable 250g pouches. Nobody has to be home.

intro.heading: Three choices, then *we take it* from there.
intro.body: Setting up takes about two minutes. After that, the only thing left to do is drink the coffee.

blocks.title: Pick a roast profile
blocks.body: Bright and fruity, round and chocolatey, or a rotating surprise from whichever farm has just landed.

blocks.title: Tell us how you brew
blocks.body: Whole bean, or ground for espresso, filter, cafetière or moka pot. We grind seconds before sealing the bag.

blocks.title: Choose your rhythm
blocks.body: Every week, fortnight or month. Change it or skip a delivery whenever you like.

blocks.title: We roast, then post
blocks.body: Beans are roasted on Monday and Thursday mornings and handed to the courier the same afternoon.

intro.heading: We know the *farms*. You will too.
intro.body: Every bag names the farm, the altitude and the person who grew it. We visit each partner once a year and publish what we paid them.

media.prompt: Terraced coffee farm on a misty mountain hillside at dawn, rows of coffee shrubs, a small drying shed in the distance

intro.heading: The delivery people *actually* wait in for.

blocks.text: I did not think I could taste the difference. Then a bag arrived four days after roasting and I threw the old jar away.
blocks.author: Priya Raman

blocks.text: Changing my order is a text message. A person answers. I have recommended Northfold on that alone.
blocks.author: Tom Ellery

blocks.text: We switched the whole studio over. Nine of us, three bags a week, and nobody has asked for the pods back.
blocks.author: Hana Okafor

intro.heading: One bag, or a *full shelf*.
intro.body: Free delivery on every plan. No contract, and you can cancel in one click.

blocks.name: The Regular
features: Free brew guide with every box

intro.heading: Things people ask *before* subscribing.
intro.body: Still unsure? Text 07700 900123 and one of the roasters will reply.

blocks.q: How fresh is the coffee when it arrives?
blocks.a: Usually two to four days after roasting, which is when most beans start tasting their best. The roast date is printed on every bag.

blocks.q: Can I change or pause my subscription?
blocks.a: Yes. Text us or use the link in any delivery email. Changes made before 9am on a roast day apply to that delivery.
Whole bean if you own a grinder. Otherwise tell us how you brew and we will grind to match, seconds before the bag is sealed.

blocks.q: Do you deliver outside the UK?
blocks.a: Not yet. We would rather not ship coffee that spends a week in transit.

blocks.q: What if I do not like a roast?
blocks.a: Tell us and the next bag is free. We will also suggest a profile that suits you better.

intro.heading: Your first bag is *on us*.
intro.body: Try any roast free. If it is not the best coffee you have made at home, cancel and keep the bag.
